scraped_content.meta_description: Idaho Arms and Ammo is a premier gun shop in Meridian, offering a wide selection of guns, ammunition, and accessories from trusted brands.

ai_content.description:
You gotta check out Gun Shop Meridian down in Meridian, Idaho. I've been takin' my buddies there for years when we're lookin' for new gear or just need some advice from a local expert. The owner's a good ol' boy who knows his stuff and can point you in the right direction whether you're lookin' for a rifle or just want to pick up some ammo.

They've got everything you'd need for huntin', fishin', or just plain ol' shootin' for fun. They even have a little archery range set up out back where you can try your hand at it. And if you're plannin' a trip into the wilderness, they'll hook you up with all the maps and guides you need to navigate the area.

It's easy to find, just take exit 11 off I-84 and head south on Eagle Road - can't miss it! They're open till 6 PM most nights, so even if you're finishin' up a long day of fishin', you can still stop by and get what you need. Just be respectful, folks, this is a local business and they appreciate your support.

You gotta check out Firearm & Ammo Shop at Meridian SCHEELS - it's one of my go-to spots when I'm gearin' up for a hunt or just need some supplies for the backyard. They're located right off the main drag in Meridian, so it's easy to swing by on your way home from work.

I've been doin' business with these folks for years and they always hook me up with what I need. They've got a great selection of firearms, ammo, and gear - from hunting rifles to handguns, and everything in between. Plus, their staff knows their stuff, so if you're new to huntin' or just lookin' for some advice, they'll give it to ya straight.

As an Idahoan, I appreciate that they cater to our outdoor lifestyle. They've got gear for fishin', huntin', and even some of that ATV stuff. And if you're lookin' for somethin' specific, just ask - they're local folks themselves, so they know what we need out here.

It's a great place to grab whatever you need for your next adventure, whether it's in the mountains or right in your own backyard.

scraped_content.page_title: Idaho Arms and Ammo Store: Gun Shop Meridian
scraped_content.meta_description: Idaho Arms and Ammo is a premier gun shop in Meridian, offering a wide selection of guns, ammunition, and accessories from trusted brands.

ai_content.description:
You gotta check out Gun Shop Meridian down in Idaho - it's one of my go-to spots for all things firearms and outdoor gear. I've been takin' my kids there since they were old enough to hold a rifle, and we always find what we need. It's run by some good folks who know the area like the back of their hand.

They're located right off Highway 66 in Meridian, easy to get to from anywhere in the Treasure Valley. And with all the hunting and fishin' opportunities around here, you can bet they've got everything you need for a successful trip. I mean, have you seen the selection of optics they carry? They've got binoculars for spotting elk, riflescopes for long-range shots... it's impressive.

And if you're new to the area or just gettin' back into huntin', their folks are happy to give you some advice on where to go and what to expect. We're a community-driven state here in Idaho, and Gun Shop Meridian is definitely part of that fabric.

ai_content.description:
You folks gotta check out Firearm & Ammo Shop at Meridian SCHEELS - it's our go-to place for all things firearms and outdoor gear. I've lived around here my whole life, and I can tell you, they're one of the best in the Treasure Valley. They've got a huge selection of rifles, shotguns, handguns, and ammo, so whether you're a hunter or just like to shoot for fun, they've got you covered.

But what really sets 'em apart is their expertise. The guys who work there are super knowledgeable about all the local laws and regulations, plus they've got experience with all sorts of outdoor activities - fishing, hunting, camping, you name it. They'll help you find exactly what you need to get out on the river or in the woods.

And let's be real, folks - we live in a state where the great outdoors is right at our doorstep. We should take advantage of that! Firearm & Ammo Shop makes it easy with their convenient location near the Interstate and plenty of parking. Plus, they're open late for those of us who like to get out under the stars. Give 'em a shot - you won't be disappointed!

Bishop Ammunition & Firearms
God Bless the 2nd Amendment

Bishop Ammunition & Firearms is located in Pocatello, Idaho. We are a fully Federal Firearms Licensed (FFL) Class 7 manufacturer. If you need a transfer, please contact Bishop's Gun Barn at 208-233-3912, Tuesday through Saturday, 10am-6pm.

If you need to contact us, our business office address is:

Bishop Ammunition & Firearms
8249 W Portneuf Rd
Pocatello, ID 83204
(208) 240-6727

We manufacture rifles and accessories in AR-15, AR-10, and bolt action platforms. We build our rifles to quality standards and stand behind our work.

We produce high quality small arms ammunition for the avid sportsman and cowboy action shooter in lead, TMJ, FMJ, jacketed lead, and solid copper projectile caliber types. We produce 475 Bishop Short Magnum, 375 Bishop Short Magnum, 458 SOCOM, 45 Colt (45 Long Colt), 45 Auto (45 ACP), 41 Magnum, 44 Special, 38 Special, 357 Magnum handgun calibers, as well as cowboy action loads. The smokeless powder we use in our bulk ammunition is sourced from American companies and we only use the best clean burning smokeless powder available.

We maintain a list of retailers from who you can buy our products, or you may order directly from us via our online retail store. Please note that in California, as of this writing, ammunition must be shipped to your local ammunition vendor or FFL, and rifles must be shipped to your local FFL for pickup.

Bishop Ammunition & Firearms was founded by Merrisa and Dianne Bishop, both U.S. Military veterans who have served in times of conflict. Merrisa, our President, is a disabled combat veteran and former Army military police officer and long-range marksman. She does our research and development of our rifles and ammunition products as well as building our rifles. Dianne is a U.S. Air Force active duty and reserve veteran who was involuntary recalled to active duty and served during the Gulf War. Dianne takes care of all graphic design, website, and ammunition production.

You may reach us at [email protected] or phone us at (208) 240-6727.

Our business Facebook and Instagram pages is located at @bishopammo

God Bless the 2nd Amendment.

scraped_content.page_title: Gunsmithing Services in Meridian | Idaho Arms & Ammo
scraped_content.meta_description: Expert gunsmithing services in Meridian. Idaho Arms & Ammo offers cleaning services, repairs, trigger upgrades, modifications, custom builds, and more.

ai_content.description:
If you're lookin' for gear and know-how around these parts, Idaho Arms & Ammo is the place to go. I've been takin' my rig there for years, and they've always treated me right. They're located just off of Eagle Road in Meridian, easy to find if you're comin' from Boise or Nampa.

These folks know their stuff when it comes to firearms and outdoor gear. They've got a great selection of guns, ammo, and accessories for huntin', fishin', and just plain ol' shootin' time. And if your rifle needs some TLC, they've got top-notch gunsmiths on hand to fix it up.

If you're into the outdoors like I am, you'll appreciate their expertise on everything from hunting seasons to outdoor safety tips. They're not just a store, they're part of the community. They know our hills and rivers, and they can point you in the right direction for your next adventure. Just head down to Idaho Arms & Ammo and ask around – they'll set you straight!

ai_content.description:
You gotta check out RK Gunsmithing.net, folks! It's your go-to resource for all things firearms and outdoor gear in Idaho. I've been using it for years myself, and it's been a lifesaver when I need to find a good gunsmith or track down some hard-to-find hunting gear.

First off, the website's got a comprehensive list of gun shops, ranges, and outfitters across the state. You can search by region, so whether you're up in Coeur d'Alene or down in Twin Falls, you'll be able to find what you need. Plus, they've got reviews from other folks who've used these places, which is super helpful.

And it's not just about guns - RK Gunsmithing.net also lists all sorts of outdoor gear shops and services: fishing guides, horse rentals, even ATV trails! It's like having a local buddy show you around the best spots. Just click on what you're looking for, and off you go. Trust me, you won't be disappointed.

scraped_content.meta_description: Idaho Arms and Ammo is a premier gun shop in Meridian, offering a wide selection of guns, ammunition, and accessories from trusted brands.

ai_content.description:
Here's a write-up for Idaho Arms and Ammo Store: Gun Shop Meridian:

You gotta check out Idaho Arms and Ammo Store down in Meridian - it's one of our local favorites, folks! If you're lookin' for gear to hit the trails or just need some advice on how to get started with huntin', they've got you covered. They've been around for years, so they know what we love about this state: gettin' outside and enjoyin' nature.

Head on down there and you'll see all sorts of firearms, ammo, and accessories - plus a great selection of optics and gear from top brands. If you're new to the area or just lookin' for some expert advice, their folks are super knowledgeable and friendly. They've got a wide range of experience and can help with everything from target shootin' to big game hunts.

Conveniently located on the west side of Meridian, it's easy to swing by after work or on your way out to the mountains. And if you're not lookin' for gear at all, just stop in and say hi - they've got a great community feel goin' on in there.

These simulators provide a safe and controlled setting for users to practice marksmanship, decision-making, and tactical responses without the risks or costs associated with live ammunition. They are commonly used by military, law enforcement, and civilian firearm trainers to enhance shooting skills, improve reaction times, and refine judgment under pressure.
